tools.name: get_supported
tools.description: The (x402Version, scheme, network) kinds and extensions this facilitator verifies and settles. Same answer as GET /supported.

tools.name: get_config
tools.description: Every settleable asset with its address, decimals, transfer method and EIP-712 domain values, plus the pricing model (gas at cost, plus a fee in basis points on the payment value when the asset has a USD price), the gas fallback and the free-credit allowances. Same answer as GET /api/config.

tools.name: get_health
tools.description: Whether the facilitator behind this host is answering. Same answer as GET /health.

tools.name: verify_payment
tools.description: Check a signed x402 payment against its requirements: signature, amount, balance and simulation. Moves no funds. Same answer as POST /verify, and it spends the same per-IP allowance.

x402Version.description: x402 protocol version of the payload, e.g. 2.

paymentRequirements.description: The PaymentRequirements the resource server stated.

tools.name: payment_status
tools.description: Whether a signed payment authorization has been used on chain, for a client whose settle reply was lost. Answers unspent, consumed or expired from the chain (EIP-3009 authorizationState, or the Permit2 nonce bitmap). unspent is not final: the authorization can still be used until validBefore, and a settlement already in flight reads as unspent here. Only consumed and expired are final; expired is only reported 5 s after validBefore, so a payment still in flight is not called final. The settled and pending states need the owning API key and are only served over HTTP. Same answer as GET /settle/status, and it spends the same per-IP allowance.

asset.description: Token address the payment was signed for.

nonce.description: EIP-3009: the 32-byte hex nonce. Permit2: the nonce as a decimal or 0x-hex uint256.

validBefore.description: Optional. The authorization's validBefore (Permit2: deadline), in unix seconds, so an unused one more than 5 s past it reads as expired.
